jobs.tierReason: auto-approval policy for hand-build windows and git push; a bypass lets a session push or rewrite the repo unattended
jobs.prompt: Fifth static security review of coordination/review/aa-new5.diff (auto-approve windows, now redesigned: a policy window covers git ONLY through 'swarm handbuild git SUBCOMMAND' which runs a pinned git binary in a clean environment, performs every policy check and the git command atomically in one process; plain git is never covered by a policy window; tools/auto-approve-policy.mjs and the hooks in tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/self-approval.mjs, tools/swarm.mjs). The fourth review (FAIL) found: H hardened git command only logged and never enforced; H system gitconfig never checked and GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM allowed; H absolute-path git no longer classified as git by the main guard; M symlinked folders for new files; M git add options (pathspec-from-file, -f, --chmod, backslash normalisation); M global remote urls allowed but unchecked; M weak trusted-git check (PATH); M wrong environment checked; M folders and code files in windows; L env overrides of the policy file, stats never initialised, SAFE_SWARM still loose, two checks failing open on git errors, missing policy row crash, ssh config unprotected. Check each is really fixed by the redesign and look for NEW bypasses: the new swarm handbuild git subcommand itself (argument injection into git, option abuse such as --upload-pack, --exec-path, -C, --git-dir, -c, config subcommand, alias expansion, remote helpers, hooks via core.hooksPath or templates, hook scripts in the common git dir, pushing to a different URL than checked), the matcher for the installed swarm path, how the guard treats everything else, TOCTOU between check and run, and any fail-open path. No exploit commands: class and fix. Verdict PASS or FAIL, ranked findings with severity and file and line.
